module: "Dummy shaft" device that serves as a torsion reactor: it transmits the torque of its parent to its children (multiplied by gearRatio) while keeping the torque reaction nodes (torqueReactionNodes_nodes) that allow applying the engine torque reaction to the body. The powertrain uses it as the anchor point for torque reactions. Category shaft, a single output port.
notes: jbeam keys: gearRatio (1), torqueReactionNodes_nodes (list of 3 node numbers, only numbers are kept; absent = nil), electricsName, visualShaftAVName, inputName, inputIndex. breakTriggerBeam is always nil.

validate: if the number of reaction nodes is not exactly 3, a warning is logged and torqueUpdate is replaced by updateTorqueDisabled, which does EXACTLY the same thing as updateTorque (no real effect, the two functions are identical).

velocityUpdate writes device.parent[device.parentOutputAVName] = inputAV (parent field, name supplied by the powertrain), and torqueUpdate reads device.parent[device.parentOutputTorqueName]: these two names are set by powertrain.lua during wiring.

Minor bug: new() reads shallowcopy(M.requiredExternalInertiaOutputs) while M.requiredExternalInertiaOutputs is not defined in this file (nil): device.requiredExternalInertiaOutputs is therefore nil (shallowcopy of nil).
Minor bug: new() does not copy gearRatio to reset; reset(device, jbeamData) rereads jbeamData.gearRatio (1 by default), which is consistent. But onBreak = nop (nop is a game global).

new.desc: Builds the device from the jbeam. Filters torqueReactionNodes_nodes to keep only the numeric values.

device.desc: Object returned by new(jbeamData). Fields: gearRatio, inputAV, outputAV1 (rad/s), outputTorque1 (N·m), torqueReactionNodes (list of 3 nodes or nil), cumulativeInertia (kg·m²), cumulativeGearRatio, parent/children (set by the powertrain).

velocityUpdate.desc: Physics step: inputAV = outputAV1 * gearRatio, then copied into the parent field designated by parentOutputAVName.

torqueUpdate.desc: Physics step: outputTorque1 = output torque of the parent * gearRatio.

validate.desc: Checks that the parent exists and that torqueReactionNodes contains 3 nodes (otherwise a warning and torqueUpdate disabled by name only).

calculateInertia.desc: Computes the cumulative inertia (that of the child divided by gearRatio²), its inverse and the cumulative ratios from the first child.

reset.desc: Resets speeds, torque and inertias; rereads gearRatio from the jbeam.
